note: Europe PMC indexes bioRxiv/medRxiv preprints; searched separately so preprints are never silently merged with peer-reviewed evidence.

layers.term: ("systemic sclerosis" OR scleroderma) AND (cGAS OR STING OR TMEM173 OR MB21D1 OR "stimulator of interferon genes") AND (SRC:PPR)

policy.dedup: if a peer-reviewed version exists, keep the published record and link the preprint as previous_version; never double count
